expanded_science_tooluniverse.title: expanded_science_tooluniverse
expanded_science_tooluniverse.caption: ToolUniverse v3 supplementary S8, Figure S2, PDF pp.23–24. Matched Claude Code / Claude Opus 4.8 point estimates on 60 DbQA and 70 SeqQA questions. Same agent/base model with and without ToolUniverse. Refusals and unparsable answers count as incorrect. Values are reported percentages; do not reconstruct integer successes from them.
expanded_science_tooluniverse.assumptions: Point estimates only for this comparison; no sampling interval supplied. Biomedical tasks, not grid engineering. The overall platform effect does not isolate each module.
expanded_science_tooluniverse.credit: Original plot of author-reported paper data; full protocol and limitations in the reading guide

expanded_science_txagent.title: expanded_science_txagent
expanded_science_txagent.caption: TxAgent v1 Results, PDF p.10, Figure 1d. Open-ended DrugPC accuracy; DrugPC has 3,168 questions. TxAgent is fine-tuned Llama 3.1-8B plus ToolRAG and 211 tools; comparison models differ in training and tool access. Methods 5.2, PDF p.61: answers generated without choices are mapped back to the original multiple-choice options for scoring.
expanded_science_txagent.assumptions: A system comparison, not a same-model tool ablation or direct free-text semantic grading. Rounded author percentages; no reconstructed success counts or uncertainty. Benchmark answers, not prospective clinical outcomes.
expanded_science_txagent.credit: Original plot of author-reported paper data; full protocol and limitations in the reading guide

expanded_science_txagent_ablation.title: expanded_science_txagent_ablation
expanded_science_txagent_ablation.caption: TxAgent v1 Results p.17; Figure 3c graphic/caption pp.27–28; Online Methods 6.1 pp.61–62. ToolUniverse services are replaced by LLMs prompted to mimic tool behavior. DrugPC is multiple-choice here: actual tools 93.8%, GPT-4o mimic 72.7%, Llama 3.1-8B mimic 68.7%.
expanded_science_txagent_ablation.assumptions: Different output setting from the 92.1% open-ended score; do not combine them. Source reports other settings held unchanged; no uncertainty interval supplied. Demonstrates this benchmark comparison, not correctness of all external tools.
expanded_science_txagent_ablation.credit: Original plot of author-reported paper data; full protocol and limitations in the reading guide

expanded_science_popper.title: expanded_science_popper
expanded_science_popper.caption: POPPER ICML2025 Table 3, PDF p.6: DiscoveryBench comparison, mean ± standard deviation across 5 independent runs, nominal alpha 0.1. ReAct Type-I error 0.078±0.061/power 0.383±0.017; no relevance check 0.134±0.021/0.610±0.042; POPPER0.103±0.020/0.638±0.066. Values multiplied by 100 for percent axes. Each run uses 86 non-null and 86 constructed-null cases; Claude-Sonnet-3.5, at most three tests per hypothesis. Repeated runs do not create 430 independent hypotheses.
expanded_science_popper.assumptions: Whiskers are standard deviations, not 95% confidence intervals. Power is rejection probability on non-null hypotheses; Type-I error is rejection on nulls. The observed POPPER mean slightly exceeds nominalalpha; theoretical control requires its assumptions. Appendix protocol constructs null tests via data permutations.
expanded_science_popper.credit: Original plot of author-reported paper data; full protocol and limitations in the reading guide

expanded_science_popper_failures.title: expanded_science_popper_failures
expanded_science_popper_failures.caption: POPPER AppendixD, PDF p.15, Figure 5: selected failure labels among 128 failed experiment logs. Multiple labels may occur per log. Labels generated by o1;30 labeled logs manually checked with 93.3% agreement.
expanded_science_popper_failures.assumptions: Conditional sample of failed logs, not all attempts; percentages are not unconditional system failure probabilities and need not sum to 100. Shown five categories, not full taxonomy.
expanded_science_popper_failures.credit: Original plot of author-reported paper data; full protocol and limitations in the reading guide
